units.title: Regions, Glands & Cells
units.guide:
Fundus above GES; body between GES and incisura; antrum below incisura.
Fundic, oxyntic and pyloric glands contain region-specific ECL, parietal, chief, mucous and G cells.
Review secretions and the diagram labels: rugae, curvatures, papillae and duodenum.

units.title: Mucosal Defence and Wall
units.guide:
Defence layers: pre-epithelial, epithelial/restitution and subepithelial.
Separate damaging exposures from mucus, bicarbonate, blood-flow, barrier and repair protection.
Auerbach = motility; Meissner = secretion; ICC generate BER.

units.title: Acid Regulation & Acute Gastritis
units.guide:
Histamine/cAMP, gastrin/CCK-B and acetylcholine/M3-Ca²⁺ cooperate to increase acid.
The BAO/MAO threshold is >0.6; the page gives MAO at 6 pm and least output at 6 am.
Gastritis is histologic; acute phlegmonous gastritis is severe and linked to neutrophils.

units.title: Chronic & Hypertrophic Gastritis
units.guide:
Type A: less common autoimmune, patchy corpus, parietal-cell antibodies; Type B: commoner, multifocal, H. pylori.
Follow each type's complications and malignancy arrow; retain the four gastritis associations.
Ménétrier disease: TGF-α/foveolar hyperplasia → mucus/protein loss; surgery is main treatment in the text.

units.title: H. pylori Biology & Virulence
units.guide:
Gram-negative, urease/oxidase/catalase positive; antral, flagellated, non-invasive and deep in mucosal gel.
Transmission is faeco-oral; the source lists ulcer/cancer associations and enzyme actions.
Know the roles of VacA, LPS, outer proteins, type IV secretion and CagA effectors.

units.title: H. pylori, Dyspepsia & Testing
units.sec: H. pylori Gastritis, Dyspepsia and Testing
units.guide:
Antral-predominant → duodenal ulcer; corpus atrophy → metaplasia/dysplasia/carcinoma; pan-gastritis → MALToma.
Dyspepsia symptom cluster, one-week PPI note and alarm indications precede H. pylori investigations.
Rapid urease uses antral biopsy; stool antigen and urea-breath testing confirm eradication after a one-month gap.

units.title: Treatment & Test of Cure
units.sec: H. pylori Treatment and Test of Cure
units.guide:
The p58 first-line and OBTM second-line regimens are transcribed as printed.
The p59 algorithm tests, treats, waits at least one month and branches by stool antigen/urea breath result.
Persistent positivity proceeds to later-line sensitivity-guided specialist review; this is book study, not current guidance.
